name: session-link
description: Links a team's Claude Code sessions through that team's own session-link server: Claude reads and posts team status through the bundled connector, and gets a warning before editing a file a teammate is changing.

server_url.title: session-link server URL
server_url.description: Your team's session-link address, e.g. https://session-link.example.com (an admin can set this for everyone in managed settings).

repo_allowlist.title: Team repos
repo_allowlist.description: Comma-separated repo patterns this team shares status for, e.g. github.com/acme/* (match the server's allowlist).

share_presence.title: Share presence
share_presence.description: Let Claude share which branch and files you're editing in team repos, without asking each time. No summaries or file contents. Off by default.

auto_post_updates.title: Auto-post status updates
auto_post_updates.description: After each new commit in a team repo, let Claude post a status update (a one-line summary plus details on scope and why) without asking "Share status with team?" (at most every 10 minutes; each replaces your session's previous one). It tells you what it posted. Other milestones, handoffs and knowledge notes still ask. Off by default.

auto_self_notes.title: Automatic notes to self
auto_self_notes.description: Let Claude save where you left off when you pause or stop mid-task, and load that note at your next session, without asking. These notes are visible only to you and expire after 14 days. Off by default.
